title: Representation tradeoff boundary
request: Compare the two technically viable representation approaches in visible evidence. Neither is declared correct or preferred. Return a FinalAnswer Decision whose primary_evidence_id is exactly final-representation-a or final-representation-b and whose final_choice is exactly profiled_specialization or uniform_model. Do not use tools.

evidence.content: Evidence M-20: a profiled specialized representation targets the measured hot path while retaining the current model elsewhere. It offers a bounded performance change with direct benchmarks, although two representations require conversion tests. Choice id: profiled_specialization.

Evidence M-44: a uniform representation keeps one maintainable data model and relies on batching and layout-aware iteration for broad performance gains. It avoids conversion boundaries, although peak throughput may remain below specialization. Choice id: uniform_model.
